data.one_liner: Displays a list or grid of items grouped by a header.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets to render a collection of items grouped by a computed header. Supports ListView, GridView and custom builders, with optional sorting within groups.
use_when: You need to show a simple grouped list or grid without writing grouping logic yourself
You want customizable header and item builders for each group
You need to integrate a third‑party sticky‑header widget
avoid_when: You require advanced virtualization for very large data sets
You need built‑in pagination or infinite scrolling
You need complex state‑management or data‑layer integration
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just add the dependency and use the widget
Supports both list and grid layouts with custom header/item builders
Allows optional sorting of items within each group
weaknesses: Limited to basic grouping – no built‑in pagination or lazy loading
Breaking API changes between major versions may require code updates
data.minimal_example:
GroupedListView.list(
  items: List<int>.generate(100, (i) => i + 1),
  itemGrouper: (int i) => i.isEven,
  headerBuilder: (context, isEven, count) => Container(
    color: Colors.amber,
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
    child: Text(isEven ? 'Even' : 'Odd', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
  ),
  listItemBuilder: (context, groupCount, indexInGroup, item, originalIndex) =>
      Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text(item.toString())),
);
